fields.name: wavesPerFloor
fields.title: Waves per floor
fields.description: How many waves make up one floor. Source WaveManager.WAVES_PER_FLOOR (every 10 waves = 1 floor).

fields.name: autoWaveInterval
fields.title: Auto-wave interval (s)
fields.description: Seconds between auto-spawned waves; paused during boss waves. Source WaveManager.AUTO_WAVE_INTERVAL.

fields.name: earlyClearDelay
fields.title: Early-clear delay (s)
fields.description: Short delay before the next wave when the current non-boss wave is cleared before the auto-timer fires. Source WaveManager.EARLY_CLEAR_DELAY.

fields.name: floorIntroDelay
fields.title: Floor-intro delay (s)
fields.description: Wall-clock pause after a floor advance (King kill) before any new-floor wave logic ticks, so the celebration plays. Source WaveManager.FLOOR_INTRO_DELAY.

fields.name: bossWaves
fields.title: Boss-wave positions
fields.description: The wave-in-floor positions (1..wavesPerFloor) that are boss waves. Source WaveManager BOSS_WAVE_PRINCE/QUEEN/KING (4/7/10).

fields.name: bossSequence
fields.title: Boss sequence
fields.description: The royals spawned at each boss wave, in order (Prince -> Queen -> King). References the bossType schema.

fields.name: hpCurve
fields.title: HP scaling curve
fields.description: Per-floor enemy HP/damage scaling curve. Source getFloorScaling HP 1.3^(floor-1).

fields.name: countCurve
fields.title: Count scaling curve
fields.description: Per-floor enemy count scaling curve. Source getFloorScaling count 1.2^(floor-1).
